name: Goldsmith Remodel and Design

gbp_reviews_visible.text: I found Joe on Google. After reading many of his reviews and looking at photos of his previous projects, I decided to hire Joe and his team. I’m glad I did. …

We couldn’t be happier with how everything turned out! From the beginning, Joe was great to work with — professional, honest, and clearly knowledgeable about what he does. Joe also helped us with selecting quality materials. …

100% would recommend working with Goldsmith remodeling. Their quote was very reasonable and when I changed the design Joe pivoted without difficulty. His communication was great from quote to finished product. Will use them again in the future!

decision_maker.name: Joe Goldsmith
decision_maker.quote: Joe Goldsmith Owner | Project Manager | Lead Carpenter

assessment: Opinion: a small, owner-operated Rochester MN kitchen/bath/basement remodeller with strong reviews and a named owner with a direct address; a clean but thin Squarespace site with no project dating or blog, so a portfolio-driven rebuild is the natural pitch.
